equations: x(k+1) = Ad x(k) + Bd u(k) + ed;  y(k) = Cd x(k) + directTerm u(k) + fd
units: u [N], y [m], tS [s]; the 750 Hz path of p3BoucWenSimulate (interp(u, 20) to 15 kHz)
